title: What Test-Time Training Corrects in Latent World Models? A Slow-Fast Approach
abstract: arXiv:2611.29453v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Latent world models plan toward a goal by predicting the outcomes of candidate actions, but under the distribution shift, prediction errors can lead the planner astray. Test-time training using executed actions helps, yet what it corrects and whether its updates should persist across episodes remains unclear. We address both by analyzing the world model's prediction error. On PushObj, an object-pushing task, we probe multiple actions from the same state and decompose the error into an offset shared across actions and an action-dependent component. The offset effectively shifts the planner's goal, and AdaJEPA mainly tracks it: the common shift alone recovers 91% of its planning gain. Part of the offset is episode-specific, so carrying its correction into the next episode does not help and may even hurt. The remaining offset recurs across episodes and action-dependent error can be or needs to be learned and retained from many episodes. O

translated_title: 测试时训练在潜在世界模型中修正了什么？一种慢-快方法
translated_abstract: 潜在世界模型通过预测候选动作的结果来朝目标进行规划，但在分布偏移下，预测误差可能会使规划器误入歧途。利用已执行的动作进行测试时训练有所帮助，然而它究竟修正了什么，以及其更新是否应该在多个回合（episode）之间持续保留，仍不清楚。我们通过分析世界模型的预测误差来回答这两个问题。在PushObj（一个物体推动任务）上，我们从同一状态探测多个动作，并将误差分解为跨动作共享的偏移量和一个依赖于动作的分量。该偏移量实际上会移动规划器的目标，而AdaJEPA主要跟踪的正是它：仅这一共同偏移就能恢复其规划增益的91%。偏移量的一部分是回合特定的，因此将其修正带入下一个回合并无帮助，甚至可能有害。其余的偏移量会在多个回合中重复出现，而依赖于动作的误差可以在许多回合中学习并保留（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文通过将世界模型预测误差分解为跨动作共享的偏移量与动作相关分量，揭示了测试时训练主要修正的是共享偏移量（仅此即可恢复91%的规划增益），并据此提出一种区分回合内快速修正与跨回合慢速学习的慢-快方法。
en_tdlr: This paper decomposes world model prediction errors into a shared cross-action offset and an action-dependent component, showing that test-time training mainly corrects the shared offset (recovering 91% of planning gain), and proposes a slow-fast approach that separates episode-specific fast corrections from slow learning retained across episodes.
